text: tlh-gui is a GUI for The Last Harness built as a standalone copy of get-bb/bb, deliberately not a GitHub fork. Diego wants it to stay relatively close to upstream so it keeps benefiting from bb's ongoing development: keep fork deltas small and inventoried, and leave upstream identity and behavior alone unless a delta is explicitly approved.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: The repo is public on purpose (Diego, 2026-10-06). Public repos get unlimited free standard GitHub-hosted runners, which replace upstream's paid Blacksmith runners for fork CI, and the desktop auto-updater fetches release metadata from GitHub release assets without auth, which only works on a public repo. Making it private would break both.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>

text: Diego intends to eventually fork bb's mobile app (apps/mobile) too. Until then apps/mobile, its upstream mobile workflows (disabled in repo settings), and the in-app links to bb's TestFlight/APK stay exactly as upstream ships them; repoint them when the mobile fork happens rather than hiding them now.
author: Diego Petrucci <baulei@icloud.com>
